name: liveswe
description: Live-SWE-agent: mini-swe-agent with upstream's self-evolving configuration — the agent is told to create its own Python tools (at least an edit tool) and is prompted after every command to consider new tools; same sandbox, bug report and patch export as miniswe (only Live-SWE-agent's config changes differ; step limit 250)
reference: C. S. Xia, Z. Wang, Y. Yang, Y. Wei, L. Zhang. Live-SWE-agent: Can Software Engineering Agents Self-Evolve on the Fly? arXiv:2511.13646, 2025.
